logo.title: The Seal.
logo.lead: A simple round seal with an italic "B&": the firm's initial and the ampersand of partnership. It's traditional without being stuffy. Copper on slate, like a brass nameplate on a Broadway door. The wordmark is set in EB Garamond.

story.title: Stratford's solicitors since 1957.
story.lead: On 17 July 1957, Gilbert Bowling began practising in a few rooms above Burton's on Stratford Broadway, having talked the rent down from £200 to £175 a year. Nearly seventy years later, Bowling & Co is still on the Broadway, advising individuals and businesses across East London. The brand should feel like a good solicitor: calm, clear, trustworthy, and human.
story.positioning: Stratford's long-established law firm. Clear advice for people and businesses, from a firm that's been on the Broadway since 1957.

colour.title: Slate, parchment, copper.
colour.lead: Deep slate is authority without the cliché of navy-and-gold. Parchment is warmth, and copper, like a brass nameplate, marks actions and details.

type.title: Classic serif, clear sans.
type.lead: EB Garamond carries tradition and trust. Public Sans, a typeface designed for public-service clarity, keeps fees and service details plain. Both are free on Google Fonts.

samples.label: Body
samples.text: We'll tell you what it costs before we start, in writing.

voice.title: Plain English, always.
voice.lead: Explain the law the way you would to a friend across the desk. No Latin, no superlatives, and no promises of outcomes (SRA). Be warm on family matters and precise on business ones.
pairs: "Buying your first home? Here's exactly what we'll do, and what it costs."
"Going through a separation is hard. We'll take it one step at a time."

imagery.title: People, not gavels.
imagery.lead: Natural portraits of the team at work and in meetings (with consent), the Broadway office front, and Stratford streets. No gavels, scales of justice or handshake stock photography.
